# stackcone

> stackcone builds production RAG chatbots and AI agents (LangGraph, MCP, evals, citations), plus Python full-stack, data engineering, and Flutter. Founded by Amar Kumar. Fixed scope, full handover.

## About

stackcone is an AI engineering studio founded by Amar Kumar (AI & Python engineer, 10+ years). Hire on Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/agencies/2022687811186513260/ · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/stackcone/

## Services

- AI agent development and AI automation for business
- Production RAG and agentic RAG (vector search, embeddings, evaluation)
- MCP / LangGraph tool workflows with human-in-the-loop governance
- Support copilots and document intelligence
- Python full-stack web development (FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, APIs)
- Flutter mobile apps (iOS and Android)
- Data engineering and data platform migration (ETL, streaming, warehouses, dbt)
- Cloud and DevOps (AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, CI/CD) with regional residency options

## Delivery

- Remote-first with overlapping hours across time zones
- Fixed scope, milestones, and full handover (code, runbooks, docs)
- Privacy-aware design; we do not claim certifications we do not hold
